title: Coldwater Reach
blurb: Coldwater Reach, Maine, autumn 1943 through spring 1945. Three people — Eira Bowman, the fifty-two-year-old woman who holds the harbormaster post no man wanted after Pearl Harbor; Hannah Pfeiffer, seventeen, daughter of Bavarian immigrants whose dairy farm now houses four German POW laborers; and Dr. Marcus Klein, a Viennese Jewish scholar teaching high-school German in the town that hired him because it had no other choice — each carry, separately and without coordination, a piece of a single unresolved event none of them sees whole.
oneLine: Three lives in a wartime Maine fishing town, each holding a piece of one unresolved event none of them sees whole.
